description: Develop phase submit payload. Return once after implementing the immediate plan or identifying the smallest concrete blocker.

status.description: Use succeeded only when the planned implementation is complete; blocked or failed must explain the blocker in feedback.

summary.description: One to three concise sentences naming what changed or what stopped the attempt.

feedback.description: Concrete handoff for the next Plan pass. Name what changed, the blocker, or the smallest Plan recovery action; do not use placeholders like done, ok, none, or fix it.

bypassVerify.description: Set true only when the planned verify command itself is wrong or out of scope. If true, feedback must name the concrete file, suite, command, or environment detail that makes the verify command wrong plus the smallest Plan recovery action; do not use true because tests are slow, failing, unavailable in your environment, or not yet run.

lessonEdits.description: Exact lesson find/replace edits, or an empty array when there is no durable lesson to update.

find.description: Exact existing lesson text to replace; empty only when appending to empty lessons.

replaceAll.description: True only when every exact match should be replaced; otherwise false or null.
